Variants.Content: The shepherd moves with the flocks, herds, and seasons, becoming familiar with pastures, wolf tracks, and the temperament of each animal. Nobles counted livestock as wealth, and the shepherd knew that a disease or robbery could wipe out the numbers; he often spent more time with animals than talking to people.

Entry Herdsmen The shepherd moves with the flocks, herds, and seasons, becoming familiar with pastures, wolf tracks, and the temperament of each animal. Nobles counted livestock as wealth, and the shepherd knew that a disease or robbery could wipe out the numbers; he often spent more time with animals than talking to people. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.

Some people turn raw materials into tools, cloth and medicine, others set festivals and taboos for exchange; wealth is piled up by many hands, and rarely belongs to just one name.
